QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_50

question.text: Under Regulation 21A, which of the following holdings are EXCLUDED when calculating whether key personnel of a merchant banker hold more than the permissible threshold in the issuer?

answer.text: Shares held through family trusts and HUFs
Shares held through portfolio management services
Holdings through mutual funds and ESOP
Shares pledged with banks as collateral

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 21A provides that holdings in the issuer through mutual funds and employee stock option schemes (ESOPs) may be excluded when applying the key-personnel holding threshold. The Trap: The other options (PMS holdings, family trust/HUF holdings, pledged shares) are not listed among the specific exclusions in the regulation. Note: Apply only the mutual fund and ESOP exclusions specifically permitted by the regulation when computing the key-personnel threshold.
